[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
Thomas Glasgow was already dead by 9 February 1711. A letter catalogued on that date from Captain Hemington, writing at the Thistle and Crown Inn, Tower Hill, says that he was sending Thomas Glasgow’s ticket.<ref>The National Archives, Discovery, [https://discovery.nationalarchives.gov.uk/details/r/C16638332 ADM 106/663/238], folio 238,9 February 1711; official catalogue description reviewed 12 November 2026. Original manuscript not inspected; catalogue reports not digitised.</ref>

His birth, family, occupation and exact death date and place are unknown. The letter’s naval administrative context does not by itself establish a particular ship or naval rank.

== Research Notes ==
The catalogue gives no age, ship, rank, trade, birthplace, family or death place. Tower Hill identifies Captain Hemington’s writing location, not Thomas’s residence or death. None of the checked Thomas accounts is positively identified. Retain chronologically compatible candidates; missing naval details or locality alone do not exclude them. Glasgow-3943 has a later concrete death date 6 October 1725 and cannot be this deceased 1711 subject if that date belongs to him. Glasgow-1103’s circa 1675 death remains an estimated conflict, not a firm exclusion.

Compatible local candidates include [[Glasgow-2461|Thomas Glasgow (2461)]], [[Glasgow-3091|Thomas Glasgow (3091)]], [[Glasgow-3285|Thomas Glasgow (3285)]], [[Glasgow-1311|Thomas Glasgow (1311)]], [[Glasgow-1242|Thomas Glasgow (1242)]], [[Glasgow-1226|Thomas Glasgow (1226)]], [[Glasgow-3556|Thomas Glasgow (3556)]], [[Glasgow-1527|Thomas Glasgow (1527)]], [[Glasgow-1103|Thomas Glasgow (1103)]], [[Glasgow-3187|Thomas Glasgow (3187)]]. No identification or parent attachment is proposed. This is one held documentary account, not authority to create a duplicate live profile.

Bounded maintained public catalogue review of Thomas Glasgow records with explicit birth before 1712; known date/occupation/context accounts compared as leads. This is not a fresh live WikiTree duplicate search. Sparse undated Thomas accounts and names outside this exact-name selection remain unreviewed, so no live creation is recommended.
